method: Each mutant replaces `old` with `new` (exactly one occurrence) in one file of the S10 worktree at `commit`, runs `command` from the worktree root, then restores the file; the tree was clean after the run. A mutant is killed only when the replacement applied and the command exits nonzero. The no-egress test runs under strace on the measuring host (strace present), so E1 and E2 were judged with the capture active.
history: A first run at an earlier commit of the same branch left R3 surviving: the closed-once check before it made the write-once flag reachable only by a close racing another. The test "never overwrites a record that appears while it closes" was added for that case, the feature commit amended, and the set re-run (14 of 14 killed at 7ce7c500). After review, R1 was re-targeted to the new screen and R4-R6 and S3-S6 added for the withheld-command digest and the deadline statement in status; the branch was rebased onto main after S9b merged, and the whole set re-run at `commit`.
